aiTrade.lead: Automated trading assistants are common in marketing and rare in practice. The obstacle is structural, not technical — and TPIX removes both halves of it.

item1.title: Cost
item1.desc: On a fee-charging chain, a strategy that evaluates the market every minute pays gas on every evaluation and every rebalance. The fee floor eliminates most short-horizon strategies before they begin.

item2.title: Conflict of Interest
item2.desc: A centralised exchange is the counterparty to its own users. Any bot it operates sits on the wrong side of the table: it sees the order book, it holds the deposits, and its revenue rises when its users lose.

aiTrade.answer: TPIX Chain removes the first constraint — gas is zero, so a strategy may evaluate as often as it needs to. TPIX TRADE removes the second: it is a genuine DEX. User coins never leave the user's wallet, and the platform never holds a private key. AI TRADE is therefore honest by construction — the platform cannot trade against the user, front-run the user, or profit from the user's loss.
aiTrade.principle: The decision engine is a deterministic rule ensemble, not a large language model. A decision that puts real money at risk must be reproducible and auditable: given the same market data the engine returns the same answer, and every answer carries a written reason. An optional LLM advisor exists for commentary on past performance — its interface exposes no method capable of placing a trade.

strategies.grid: Buys when price dips inside its range, sells one grid step higher. One position at a time.
strategies.dca: Buys on a fixed schedule, and buys bigger when price is below its moving average.
strategies.momentum: Rides trends using an EMA crossover confirmed by volume expansion.
strategies.mean_reversion: Buys statistical oversold and sells overbought around a rolling mean.
strategies.breakout: Enters when price closes above the Donchian channel, with an ATR-scaled stop.
strategies.scalping: High-frequency micro trades on order-book imbalance. Needs tight spreads.
strategies.arbitrage: Captures the price gap between the TPIX DEX pool and the reference CEX price. Only viable because gas is zero.
strategies.ai_signal: Weighted ensemble of EMA trend, momentum, RSI mean reversion and Bollinger position, re-weighted by market regime.

aiTrade.ensembleNote: The blend is re-weighted by market regime: a directional market leans on trend and momentum, a ranging market leans on mean reversion and band position. The score must exceed a user-set confidence threshold (55–95%, default 65%) before the engine acts. The floor is 55% rather than 50% because at 50% the buy and sell gates meet exactly, the hold band vanishes, and the bot flips every tick — measured at −5.6% across 201 ticks from fees alone.
aiTrade.risk: Before any strategy acts, a risk gate combines two independent signals: price behaviour, which detects a break before the news reports it, and market news, which explains why. The gate takes the higher of the two readings, never the average — averaging lets one calm signal mask an alarming one. Its output is a full-size entry, a reduced size, a pause on new entries, or a forced exit of everything held. News is ingested from public RSS feeds and scored by weighted keyword, so any decision can be replayed afterwards.

aiTrade.custodyNote: The system holds no private key in either mode. Even with live trading enabled, AI TRADE never submits a transaction on the user's behalf — it produces a recommendation the user executes themselves. Live trading ships disabled so every user can observe a strategy's real behaviour on real prices before any capital is exposed.

constraints.item1: One position per bot — no pyramiding; a buy signal while already holding becomes hold.
constraints.item2: Tiered access — Free, Basic, Pro and VIP differ in strategy access and concurrent bot count.
constraints.item3: Work credits are denominated in TPIX only, so every bot rental is direct buy-side demand for the native coin.
constraints.item4: Cloud execution — dedicated workers evaluate strategies on a fixed cadence; no browser needs to stay open.
constraints.item5: Reproducibility harness — aibot:probe fires every strategy at known conditions and asserts decisions do not drift.

aiTrade.scope: Stated plainly, so the boundary is not inferred from marketing: the user selects the trading pair. masternode.rewardSplit: Each block reward is split: 20% to Validators (IBFT2 sealers), 35% to Guardian nodes, 30% shared among Sentinel nodes, and 15% shared among Light nodes (weighted by stake amount and uptime score).
masternode.slashing: Validators face 15% stake slashing for misbehavior. Guardian nodes face 10% slashing if offline >24h. Sentinel nodes face 5% slashing if offline >48h. Light nodes have no slashing penalty. All tiers are deregistered after 7 days offline.
masternode.afterYear3: After the 3-year reward pool is fully distributed (2028), master nodes continue earning from multiple sustainable revenue streams: (1) Transaction Fee Sharing — while end-user transactions are gasless, dApp developers and token creators pay platform fees (0.1-1% per contract deployment and token creation). 50% of these fees go to active nodes. (2) Cross-Chain Bridge Fees — every TPIX-BSC bridge transfer incurs a 0.05% fee, shared among validators. (3) Token Factory Revenue — creating tokens costs 100 TPIX, with 50% going to the node pool. (4) DEX Protocol Fees — 0.05% of every swap fee goes to the node treasury. (5) Governance Rewards — Validator-tier nodes vote on proposals and earn voting rewards. (6) Premium API Access — commercial dApps pay for priority RPC endpoints, shared among nodes.

overview.title: What is TPIX Carbon Credit?
overview.p1: TPIX Carbon Credit is a blockchain-based carbon offset marketplace built on TPIX Chain (Chain ID: 4289). It enables individuals and businesses to purchase, trade, and retire verified carbon credits with full transparency and immutability.
overview.p2: Every carbon credit represents one metric ton of CO2 equivalent (tCO2e) that has been reduced, avoided, or removed from the atmosphere through verified environmental projects. By tokenizing these credits on the blockchain, we ensure tamper-proof provenance, instant settlement, and global accessibility.
overview.p3: The platform supports multiple internationally recognized standards including VCS (Verra), Gold Standard, CDM, and ACR, making TPIX Carbon Credits compliant with global carbon trading frameworks.

why.p1: The world must reduce greenhouse gas emissions by 45% by 2030 to limit global warming to 1.5C. Carbon markets are a critical mechanism to incentivize emission reductions by putting a price on carbon.
why.p2: However, traditional carbon markets suffer from opacity, double-counting, high intermediary costs, and lack of accessibility for small participants. Blockchain technology solves these problems.

item1.desc: Traditional carbon registries are centralized databases vulnerable to manipulation. Credits can be double-counted or issued for non-existent projects.

item2.title: High Intermediary Costs
item2.desc: Brokers, exchanges, and verification bodies take 15-30% of credit value, making small projects economically unviable.

item3.title: Slow Settlement

item4.title: Limited Access

item1.title: Immutable Records

item2.title: Near-Zero Fees

item3.title: Instant Settlement

details.d1: Go to the TPIX Download page at tpix.online/download
details.d2: Download "TPIX Master Node.exe" (Portable — no installation needed)
details.d3: Or download the Installer (.exe) for permanent installation
details.d4: Place it anywhere — Desktop, Documents, etc.

s1.tip: Recommended: use the Portable version — no installation needed, just double-click to run.

s2.title: Open App & Create Wallet
s2.desc: Open TPIX Master Node and create or import a wallet

details.d2: Click the "Wallet" tab in the left sidebar
details.d3: Click "Create New Wallet" or "Import Private Key" if you already have one
details.d4: ⚠️ Important: Save your Private Key securely! It is shown only once.
details.d5: Your address will be displayed on the Wallet page

s2.tip: If you already have a wallet from MetaMask or Trust Wallet, you can export the private key and import it.

s3.title: Fund Your Wallet
s3.desc: Send enough TPIX to your address for your desired tier

details.d1: Copy your Address from the Wallet page in the app
details.d2: Send TPIX from an exchange or another wallet
details.d3: Minimum amounts by tier: Light 10,000 / Sentinel 100,000 / Guardian 1,000,000 / Validator 10,000,000 TPIX
details.d4: Wait for confirmation on TPIX Chain (~2-4 seconds)
details.d5: Check balance on the Wallet page — click "Refresh" to update

s3.tip: Buy TPIX at tpix.online/trade or Bridge from BSC at tpix.online/bridge

s4.title: Register On-Chain (Lock Your Stake)
s4.desc: Done at tpix.online/masternode — this is the step where your TPIX is actually locked into the contract

details.d1: Open tpix.online/masternode and connect the wallet holding your TPIX
details.d2: Enter your node endpoint as IP:port, e.g. 203.0.113.10:8545 — this is written to the chain permanently
details.d3: Choose a tier: Light / Sentinel / Guardian / Validator (Validator requires KYC approval first)
details.d4: Click stake and sign in your wallet — the TPIX is locked for the tier lock period
details.d5: Wait for the tx (~2-4 seconds); your node card appears with its unlock date

s4.tip: You can start with a Light Node, but changing tier means deregistering, waiting out the lock period, then registering again — the contract has no in-place upgrade.

s5.title: Launch Your Node!
s5.desc: Click Launch to start running your node

details.d2: The app will connect to TPIX Chain automatically
details.d3: Status will change to "Running" when connected
details.d4: Check Dashboard for Block Height, Peers, and Uptime
details.d5: The app runs in background — you can minimize to System Tray
details.d6: Rewards accumulate based on your uptime

s5.tip: Keep the app running 24/7 for maximum uptime and rewards. Use a VPS/Cloud for best results.

s6.title: Track Rewards & Auto-Update
s6.desc: Monitor rewards and let the app auto-update

details.d1: View accumulated rewards on the Dashboard
details.d2: The app checks the TPIX server for updates every 30 minutes
details.d3: When a new version is available, it notifies you to download + install
details.d4: View reward history and claim when the contract is ready
details.d5: The "Network" tab shows all validators and chain health

s6.tip: The more nodes running = the more stable the network. Invite your friends to run nodes too!

rewards.title: 📊 Reward System (1.4 Billion TPIX over 3 years)

That share is split EQUALLY among the active nodes in the tier, then multiplied by your node uptime — staking above the minimum earns nothing extra, and the more nodes in a tier, the less each one earns.

f1.q: Do I need to keep my computer running 24/7?
f1.a: Higher uptime = more rewards. Recommended 24/7 or use a VPS/Cloud Server.

f2.a: Yes, but each node needs its own wallet and separate stake.

f3.q: What happens if my internet disconnects?
f3.a: The node pauses temporarily. It reconnects automatically when internet returns. Light Nodes are not penalized.

f4.q: What is the difference between Validator and Guardian?
f4.a: Validators are real IBFT2 block sealers requiring 10M TPIX + company KYC, with governance voting power. Guardians are premium masternodes requiring 1M TPIX.

f5.a: Yes! IBFT2 requires 2/3 of validators online. More validators = more fault tolerance.

f6.a: Auto-updates in-app! When a new version is available, you get notified in-app. One click to update.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: TPIX is the native coin of TPIX Chain — a Polygon Edge-based blockchain with IBFT consensus, zero gas fees, and 2-second block times. TPIX powers the entire ecosystem including DEX, master node, token factory, and cross-chain bridge.
faq.a2: Each phase has its own vesting schedule. A percentage is unlocked at TGE (Token Generation Event), followed by a cliff period, then linear daily vesting over the remaining duration. The exact terms of each price tier are shown on its card above.
faq.a3: We support MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Coinbase Wallet, and OKX Wallet. Make sure your wallet is on TPIX Chain (Chain ID 4289) before purchasing — the buy form can add and switch the network for you.
faq.q4: When can I claim my tokens?
faq.a4: The TGE share of a bank transfer purchase is queued once the transfer is confirmed. Card purchases wait out a holding period first, because a card payment can still be charged back, and the date is shown next to your purchase. Remaining tokens vest according to the schedule. You can also receive wTPIX (Wrapped TPIX) on BSC as an interim tradeable token before the TPIX Chain bridge is live.

mintable.label: Mintable

pausable.label: Pausable transfers
pausable.warning: The token owner can pause all transfers at any time — while paused, no one can transfer, sell, or withdraw liquidity for this token.

blacklist.label: Blacklist
blacklist.warning: The token owner can block any wallet from transferring or selling. Blocked holders are stuck with tokens they cannot sell (can be used as a honeypot trap).

auto_burn.label: Auto-burn on every transfer
